quality_guards: Workplace-transport risk depends on site layout, vehicle type, pedestrian activity, loading tasks, traffic controls, visibility and driver competence.
HSE workplace-transport evidence is site-, vehicle-, task-, worker- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collision probability.
Lift-truck risk depends on truck type, load, route, ground condition, visibility, segregation, maintenance, supervision and operator competence.
HSE lift-truck evidence is truck-, load-, site-, operator-, maintenance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Asbestos risk depends on material type, condition, fibre release potential, disturbance, occupancy, controls, competence and work method.
HSE asbestos evidence is building-, material-, survey-, task-, worker- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level exposure probability.
Legionella risk depends on water-system design, temperature, stagnation, aerosol generation, maintenance, monitoring, occupancy and susceptibility.
HSE legionella evidence is system-, premises-, control-, exposure-, person- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level illness probability.
Noise risk depends on sound level, frequency, duration, impulsiveness, distance, controls, hearing protection and individual susceptibility.
HSE noise evidence is task-, machine-, workplace-, worker-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level hearing-loss probability.
Lyme-disease risk depends on tick species, infection prevalence, attachment duration, habitat, behaviour, clothing, removal timing and host factors.
UKHSA Lyme evidence is tick-, exposure-, person-, laboratory-, geography- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
TBE risk depends on tick distribution, virus prevalence, activity, season, exposure duration, dairy consumption, vaccination and host susceptibility.
UKHSA TBE evidence is tick-, location-, exposure-, vaccine-, patient- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Dengue risk depends on destination, season, vector abundance, local transmission, accommodation, bite prevention, immunity and traveller factors.
UKHSA dengue evidence is destination-, vector-, traveller-, exposure-, programme- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Drone risk depends on aircraft mass, category, location, airspace, people, weather, pilot competence, battery condition and operating limitations.
CAA drone evidence is aircraft-, pilot-, operation-, airspace-, environment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level incident probability.
Track-worker risk depends on possession and protection arrangements, train movements, signalling, communication, competence, fatigue, weather and worksite controls.
ORR track-worker evidence is route-, task-, protection-, worker-, operation- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level casualty probability.
